dedupe_keys.name: edge iiotset cyber security dataset for iot and iiot

description: Edge-IIoTset is a cyber security dataset for IoT and industrial IoT applications, captured on a seven-layer testbed covering cloud computing, network functions virtualisation, blockchain, fog computing, software-defined networking, edge computing and the IoT and IIoT perception layer. More than ten sensor types generate traffic, including temperature and humidity, ultrasonic, water level, pH, soil moisture, heart rate and flame sensors, and the data label fourteen attacks in five groups: denial of service, information gathering, man-in-the-middle, injection and malware. It was produced by Mohamed Amine Ferrag and colleagues and published in 2022 with a paper in IEEE Access. The 1.48 GB dataset is on IEEE DataPort, where downloading needs a subscription according to the page read, while academic use is granted free with citation; commercial use needs the lead author's permission. Caveats: the testbed mixes agricultural, water and health sensors in a laboratory, so it represents generic IIoT, not any specific plant. For simulation it trains and benchmarks intrusion detection for the sensing and control layers of infrastructure digital twins, supporting resilience studies of cyber attacks. It is related to the TON_IoT datasets record in this catalogue, a comparable IIoT security dataset.
